example: For example, you can prove you did your homework by showing it to your teacher.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To decide something or to find out the answer to a question.
example: For example, you can determine what game to play by asking your friends what they want to do.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To choose what to do or what something is after thinking about it.
example: For example, you might choose which game to play after thinking about what you like.

meaning: v.决心，决定；｛使｝分解为；解决
title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To decide to do something and try hard to do it.
example: For example, she made a resolve to study harder for her next test.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: It is the process of looking for information to find answers or learn something new.
example: For example, if you want to know why plants need sunlight, you can look up facts in books or online.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To look at something carefully or notice something that is happening
example: For example, you can watch a bird in a tree and see what it does.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To ask a question or get information about something you don't know
example: For example, if you want to know when a movie starts, you can ask the person at the ticket counter.

meaning: n.疑问；询问 v.怀疑；询问
title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A question or a request for information.
example: For example, if you don't understand something, you can ask a teacher for help.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A paper or online form with questions used to collect information from people.
example: For example, a teacher might give a form to students to find out what they think about a class.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To accomplish something means to finish it and make it happen. It is when you do what you set out to do.
example: For example, if you study hard, you can accomplish your goal of getting good grades.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To get something you want or reach a goal after trying hard.
example: For example, if you practice every day, you can get better at playing the guitar.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: It is when you get something now and pay for it later, or when you get points for doing well in school.
example: For example, if you buy a phone on credit, you can use it now and pay the money later.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A number that shows how well someone did in a game, test, or activity.
example: For example, if you get 10 questions right out of 20, your result is 10.

meaning: v.分数；标记v.标志着；v.给......打分；在....上做记号
title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To give a score or put a sign on something to show it is special or important.
example: For example, the teacher puts a red mark on your paper to show where you made a mistake.

meaning: v.给......分等级n.等级；成绩等级
title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To give something a level or score, usually based on how well it is done.
example: For example, the teacher gives a paper a grade of 90 out of 100.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: It is a way to show how good or important something is, or the position of something in a group.
example: For example, in a race, the person who finishes first has the highest rank.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A row is a line of things or people next to each other.
example: For example, the chairs in a classroom are in a row.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A line of people or things waiting for their turn.
example: For example, you might stand in a line at the store to buy something.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To give someone permission or to allow something to happen.
example: For example, the teacher allowed the students to go outside for recess.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To say something good about someone or something to show you like it.
example: For example, your teacher might say you did a great job on your homework.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To feel thankful for something or someone, or to understand how good something is.
example: For example, you might feel thankful when a friend helps you with your homework.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: It is when someone tells you what they think about something you did or made.
example: For example, if you draw a picture and your teacher says it looks nice, that is feedback.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: To think something is bigger, more important, or more valuable than it really is.
example: For example, if you think your dog is the best in the world, but other people don't agree, you might be thinking too highly of him.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A type of money given to students to help them study at a university.
example: For example, a student might get money to pay for their classes and living costs while they finish their degree.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A scholarship is money given to help someone go to school or learn more. It can also mean how much someone knows about a subject.
example: For example, a student might get a scholarship to help pay for college classes.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: Something you get because you did something good or helpful.
example: For example, if you clean your room, your parents might give you some money as a thank you.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A prize given to someone for doing something good or winning a competition.
example: For example, if you win a race, you might get a trophy or a certificate as a prize.

title: Chapter 5 学校教育
english_meaning: A prize is something you get for winning a game or competition. It can also mean to value something very much.
example: For example, if you win a race, you might get a prize like a trophy or a medal.
